offices.label: Abogado de Accidentes en Houston
offices.address: 2060 N Loop W #135, Houston, TX 77018, USA

about: Abogado de Accidentes en Houston is a personal injury firm with a single office in Houston.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; its intake line is open around the clock. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours, photo count and description come from the Places API. The services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Texas does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Texas does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile; Secretary of State registration still to confirm

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, no attorney is named on the site we could read. The gate also asks for no misleading claims, which is an editorial read we have not recorded.

G6.evidence: 206 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2025-05-08, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

operating.source: Domain registration date over RDAP, which is a lower bound on how long the firm has been operating rather than its founding date

accountability.evidence: no bar or trial lawyers' association named on the pages we read · no professional liability cover disclosed, which is not scored here: plaintiff firms in this market do not publish it, and an absence shared by every firm separates none of them

results_published.why: the site publishes no case-results page

score.verdict: 2 eligibility gate(s) still to be checked. 2 could not be answered from the available records (G1, G2) and do not count against the firm. Certification needs more of the scale measured than we have managed here, pillar A in particular. Strongest pillar: C; most headroom in pillar A (0/25).
